rows.description: violet concentric ring from a tiny brass bell
dark purple ring with soft smoky edge
two small amber eyes in small smoke wisp
grey puff with fading amber spark
black glass fragments with gold glints
gold and blue protective oval ring

One blue protective bubble shatters. Circular blue outline cracks across frames 1-4, splits into angular blue-glass shards across frames 5-8, shards scatter outward and dim through frame 12. Empty center, no character.

One compact brass pistol-wand with dark grip, short elegantly flared brass barrel, small amber chamber and tiny ivory etched details. Side view pointing right, grip pointing down-left. No hand or fighter.
One small collectible healing potion in round clear glass with ruby red liquid, brass neck collar, cork stopper and cream cross emblem. Readable bold silhouette, side view.
One collectible blue stained-glass shield crystal with a gold rim, diamond facets, ivory central star and small dark base. No ambient glow outside it.

One small reinforced wooden arena supply crate, dark brown planks, iron corner bands, brass bolt heads, alchemy circle on front. Flat side view with a tiny top bevel; solid closed state, no contents, no floor.
One squat dark oak powder barrel with two black iron bands, brass rivets, short unlit fuse and warm ivory hazard skull painted on front. Closed intact state, side view, no explosion or smoke.

One short burst of pale blue-gray STEAM expelled upward from an invisible boiler. Frame1 tiny compressed puff, frames2-4 expand, frames5-8 separate curling clumps rise, frames9-12 shrink into sparse wisps then nearly vanish.
